names: Calcium disodium ethylene diamine tetraacetate, (Calcium disodium EDTA)

more_info.overview: Calcium disodium ethylene diamine tetraacetate is used as a preservative in food. Its technological role is to help limit microbial spoilage.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include canned or bottled fruit and vegetables, heat-treated meat products, unprocessed molluscs and crustaceans, processed fish and fishery products including molluscs and crustaceans. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
